question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Gratification
solution:
The correct answer is "**Dissatisfaction**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• "**Gratification**" is the pleasing feeling you get when you achieve something you wanted or when you receive something you desired. (संतोष) 

 
 
• **Example**- Her promotion was a source of gratification.
 
 
 
• "**Dissatisfaction**" means the state of feeling dissatisfaction, a lack of satisfaction. (असंतुष्टि)
 
 
• **Example**- The customer expressed his dissatisfaction with the product's quality.
 
 
 
• Hence, the option that is opposite in meaning to the given word is "Dissatisfaction".

Therefore, the correct answer is '**option 1**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Lets see the meaning of the other options:
 
• "**Growth**" signifies the process of increasing in size. (विकास)
 
• "**Blessing**" refers to God's favor and protection. (आशीर्वाद)
 
• "**Pleasure**" is a state or feeling of happiness or satisfaction. (आनंद)
